verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a built-in AI assistant (New Relic AI) that answers questions, troubleshoots issues, explores telemetry in plain language, and helps fix queries. An in-product vulnerability agent also triages CVEs, drafts remediation steps, and can open Jira tickets or GitHub issues, which is genuine task delegation. Missing for 10: depth on the range of tasks the assistant can execute beyond querying and troubleshooting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
